Bagel paperweight bites with chive schme.d: Toasted minis spread thick with chive and black pepper cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, sesame, poppy seed and garlic.

Mob truck choc-dipped sundae cones.d: Vanilla piped high in a crisp cone, dipped in dark chocolate that sets to a shell, then crushed peanuts or sprinkles.
Mob truck choc-dipped sundae cones.note: Beats chasing the ice cream truck.

Terminal Bar burger.d: Hand-formed chuck, salted right before it hits the flat top, cooked medium under melted cheddar. Raw onion, dill pickles, toasted bun.
Terminal Bar burger.note: Hot off the grill till close.

White frosted plaster cake.d: Vanilla butter layers under a thick coat of seven-minute frosting, roughed up with a palette knife so it sets white and matte.
White frosted plaster cake.note: For the sculptors on the block.

Terminal Bar whiskey sour.d: Bourbon, lemon, a little sugar and egg white shaken silky, bitters on the foam, a cherry.
